fact: The National Information and Communications Technology Policy 2016, signed by the Minister for Works, Transport and Communication in May 2016, is presented as the Government's revision of the 2003 policy and its framework for the ICT industry.

The full policy text, with preface, contents and chapters, is published as a PDF on the Ministry's official website (mawasiliano.go.tz); the document gives no date of posting, so its May 2016 publication date is used.
The Citizen reports the ICT Commission director general saying Tanzania adopted its first National ICT Policy in 2003.

The Citizen reports the ICT Commission director general describing a 2016 policy, following the 2003 one, that put greater emphasis on digital systems and platforms; the document gives no adoption date beyond the year in the policy's name.
The Citizen reports that in 2021 the government launched a review process of the National ICT Policy (2016); no outcome is stated.
system: National ICT Policy (review of the 2016 policy)

fact: The case study states that the Information and Communication Technologies Commission (ICTC) under the Ministry of ICT has the role of ensuring smooth implementation of the National ICT Policy and related policies; it gives no date for the role, so the document's publication date (2024-11) is used.

The framework's passages refer to the National ICT Policy, 2016 (NICTP-2016) as an existing policy with subsequent reviews, and the President's statement says the National ICT Policy emphasizes the role of ICT in socio-economic goals; the framework is dated 2024, which is used as the as-of date.

The e-Government Authority's April 2021 strategic plan states it is aligned to the National ICT Policy 2016, lists it among the documents given due consideration, and says the Policy calls for strengthening institutions that coordinate, oversee, regulate and enforce e-government; no adoption date is given, so the plan's own date (April 2021) is used.

The CIPIT report says the Tanzanian government has included AI in its National ICT Policy, citing the 2016 policy of the Ministry of ICT; it gives no adoption date or status wording beyond this, and the date is the document's publication date (2025-06-25).
